lore.galacticpurpose.log1.title: [EXPEDITION LOG I — HEPHAESTUS-IV]
lore.galacticpurpose.log1.line1: Black-box transcript from Advance Crew Vega-1: Tidal heating from Erebus melted our landing struts within hours.
lore.galacticpurpose.log1.line2: We salvaged the intact Fusion Core from the caldera relay. Whoever finds this next—combine it with Pelagia's bio-matrix.
lore.galacticpurpose.log2.title: [EXPEDITION LOG II — PELAGIA-9]
lore.galacticpurpose.log2.line1: Deep submersible telemetry: Below 75 meters, hull plates buckled without reinforced Abyssal Pressure Suits.
lore.galacticpurpose.log2.line2: Thermal vents in the abyss radiate strange cellular stabilizers—this Bio-Stabilizer can mend wormhole biomatter shields.
lore.galacticpurpose.log3.title: [EXPEDITION LOG III — NYX-0]
lore.galacticpurpose.log3.line1: Final transmission from Cryo Outpost Orpheus: Drifting rogue worlds hold no warmth, yet Erebus lensing feeds quantum crystal veins.
lore.galacticpurpose.log3.line2: Forge the Quantum Core from Fusion Core, Bio-Stabilizer, and Quantum Crystal to resonate the Wormhole toward Sanctuary.
lore.galacticpurpose.log4.title: [CHRONICLE IV — SANCTUARY DAWN]
lore.galacticpurpose.log4.line1: Telemetry verified: Nitrogen-oxygen balance 21%, gravity 0.94g, stable tidal horizon bathed in Erebus golden light.
lore.galacticpurpose.log4.line2: Across Earth's fire, Mars' red sands, and three unforgiving worlds around Erebus, our Galactic Purpose is fulfilled.

codex.galacticpurpose.title: MISSION CODEX
codex.galacticpurpose.subtitle: Engineering & Survival Manual
codex.galacticpurpose.ch0.title: THE 5-STAGE GALACTIC PURPOSE
codex.galacticpurpose.ch0.intro: Our Sun is dying. Follow these 5 stages from Earth's collapse to humanity's new home across the Erebus black hole:
codex.galacticpurpose.ch0.s1.d: Mine Lead Ore, shelter underground after Day 40, craft Thermal Suit.
codex.galacticpurpose.ch0.s2.d: Power 4 machines on Mars to melt ice, grow flora & unlock breathable O2.
codex.galacticpurpose.ch0.s3.t: Stage 3 · Red Giant Storms & Exoplanet Scan
codex.galacticpurpose.ch0.s3.d: Build Lead Bunker, distill Exotic Bio-Fuel & scan 3 Coordinate Cards.
codex.galacticpurpose.ch0.s4.d: Assemble 7x5x7 Personal or 45x41x45 Ship Observatory, fuel & cool it.
codex.galacticpurpose.ch0.s5.d: Loot 3 hostile worlds -> Forge Quantum Core -> Unlock Sanctuary!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch1.title: STAGE 1: EARTH CLIMATE COLLAPSE
codex.galacticpurpose.ch1.body: Earth grows deadlier over time. Staying under a solid roof shields you from surface radiation and extreme cold:
codex.galacticpurpose.ch1.p1: Days 0–19 · STABLE: Safe surface. Mine Iron, Copper & Lead Ore!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch1.p2: Days 20–39 · WARNING: Solar instability rising. Prep rockets & gear.
codex.galacticpurpose.ch1.p3: Days 40–59 · COLLAPSE: Burning days & freezing nights outdoors!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch1.p4: Days 60+ · TERMINAL: Unlivable surface without full Thermal Suit.
codex.galacticpurpose.ch1.gear: Key Stage 1 Gear (Hover any icon to inspect):
codex.galacticpurpose.ch2.title: STAGE 2: MARS TERRAFORMING & POWER
codex.galacticpurpose.ch2.body: Place & power all 4 machines on Mars (or enable testmode for Overworld tests). Raise Heat & Pressure before Flora Oxygenator!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch2.ti1: Ti 25% · Liquid Water: Surface ice melts into lakes.
codex.galacticpurpose.ch2.ti2: Ti 45% · Biosphere Flora: Red sand turns to grass & Mars Bio-Blooms!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch2.ti3: Ti 100% · Breathable O2: Mars sky turns blue & oxygen is free!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch2.compat_body: Uses standard Fabric TeamReborn Energy + c: tags + ItemStorage! Plug in cables/batteries from Galacticraft 5, Tech Reborn, Powah, AE2, Modern Industrialization, Ad Astra & Create C&A. All recipes auto-show in REI, JEI & EMI!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch3.title: STAGE 3: RED GIANT, FUEL & TELESCOPE
codex.galacticpurpose.ch3.body: Once Mars thrives, the Sun expands into a Red Giant! Harvest Mars Bio-Blooms, refine Exotic Bio-Fuel & scan deep space:
codex.galacticpurpose.ch3.storm_body: Craft a Solar Telemetry Monitor to track storm countdowns. Survive lethal radiation waves inside an enclosed Lead-Concrete + Leaded Glass bunker OR wear a full Lead Radiation Suit!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch4.title: STAGE 4: WORMHOLE REACTOR & HOLOGRAM
codex.galacticpurpose.ch4.t1_body: 1 Core + 1 Injector (-3) + 4 Pylons (±3) + 16 Lead Concrete. Ideal for solo expeditions!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch4.t2_body: 1 Core + 1 Injector (-21) + 36 Pylons (±21). Place Ship Assembly Pad facing the Core, board Horizon Lander & double-tap [SPACE] for 10s runway launch!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch4.warn_body: Load Card, Bio-Fuel, Blue Ice Coolant & Power before Ignite! Past 9,300°C, <=15% stability, or broken pylons above 5,000°C, Quench LOCKS OUT -> 118-block Runaway Black Hole & 224-block crater!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch5.title: STAGE 5: EREBUS RUINS & RETURN FLIGHT
codex.galacticpurpose.ch5.intro: Follow the yellow HUD SIGNAL to each world's landmark ruin & fuel chest. Return by boarding your Horizon Lander (>=500 Fuel + Origin Wormhole OPEN) and double-tapping [SPACE]!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch5.p1.d: Thermal Suit. Loot the Forge Tower's Fusion Relay -> Fusion Core + fuel chest!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch5.p2.d: Pressure Suit. Dive into the Abyssal Dome -> Bio-Stabilizer + fuel chest!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch5.p3.d: Thermal Suit. Explore the Observatory -> Quantum Crystals -> Quantum Core!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch5.p4.d: Upgrade Wormhole Core with Quantum Core -> launch to humanity's new home!
codex.galacticpurpose.ch6.title: VISUAL 3x3 RECIPES & ARMOR MATRIX
codex.galacticpurpose.ch6.a1: Lead Suit: Blocks Mars Solar Storm radiation (-4% spd/pc).
codex.galacticpurpose.ch6.a2: Thermal Suit: Earth Collapse + Hephaestus + Nyx-0 (-2%/pc).
codex.galacticpurpose.ch6.a3: Pressure Suit: Pelagia-9 deep ocean crush + diving (-5%/pc).
